profile.headline: Mainframe Engineer | Systematics Developer | FinTech | Veteran
profile.summary:
I’m a veteran with a background in air traffic control operations and software development, and I love tackling complex problems in fast‑moving, high‑pressure environments. I’m always learning, always adapting, and genuinely enjoy diving into new challenges.

I’m passionate about all things technology. Over the years, I’ve worked with a mix of frontend tools like JavaScript, HTML, and CSS; done automation and API work in Python; and built most of my professional experience around mainframe programming in COBOL, REXX, File-AID Batch, JCL, and TSO/ISPF.

Right now, I’m a developer at FIS, working in the auto finance group supporting base development that gets distributed to all clients.

A bit about me personally:
I live in rural Indiana with my wife and newborn son and our two Australian Shepherds! I’m a big fan of military aviation and have built up quite a collection of books on the subject. When I’m not at my keyboard, you’ll usually find me working on home projects or relaxing with my family!

positions.title: Software Engineer Lead
positions.description:
• Lead engineer in the Auto Finance division, analyzing application code to identify root causes of defects and  implementing solutions to improve system stability and performance.  
• Design and develop enhancements for automotive lending applications, supporting both base product and  client-specific customizations in pursuit of modernization efforts.  
• Participate in cross-functional initiatives supporting application development, maintenance, and production support  activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Senior
positions.description:
Cadence Bank Dedicated Account Team
• Implemented 19 webservice APIs across multiple applications to enhance cross‑system 
communication and processing.
• Expanded expertise with CICS, architecture programming, and foundational assembler skills to support service 
functionality.
• Developed and optimized REXX tools and utilities to improve developer efficiency and reduce manual 
research time.
• Redesigned a high‑volume batch program using standard SI routines and external sort, improving runtime 
from ~40 minutes to ~1 minute.
• Created a sort‑based process to generate client‑facing CSV files, reducing data from 270,000+ records to 
~7,000 for faster analysis in Excel.

positions.title: Operations Analyst Senior
positions.description:
TD Bank Dedicated Account Team
• Improved tools supporting batch testing for development up to production environments.
• Converted multiple long‑running REXX utilities into SORT/ICETOOL processes, cutting hours‑long 
operations to create CA-7 reports down to minutes while remediating logic defects.
• Developed deeper knowledge in Endevor, JCL, SORT, ICETOOL, REXX, File-Aid batch programming and batch cycle architecture with extensive use of the CA-7 scheduler.
• Enhanced batch processing and batch cycle efficiency through targeted process improvements.

positions.title: Rising Talent Associate
positions.description:
TD Bank - Currency & Program Conversion Projects
• Updated 60+ systematics programs within a one‑month period for the annual currency initiative.
• Converted EasyTrieve programs to COBOL across deposits, savings, and safebox applications.
• Developed a program to segment accounts for loans, deposits, customer relationships, and savings applications.

First Bank of Puerto Rico - Migration
• Converted a large volume of EasyTrieve programs to COBOL, primarily in deposits and savings applications; maintained the fastest conversion‑to‑peer‑review completion rate on the team and the most total conversions.
• Served as interim team lead and offshore resource point of contact for a 13‑person conversion team for ~2 
months; handled complexity assessment, assignments, peer reviews, and progress tracking combining to 
60+ programs.

positions.title: Career transition
positions.description:
• Took intentional time after separating from the Air Force to transition into a career centered around technology and innovation.
• Continued self‑directed learning in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, while also beginning foundational work in Python.
• Enrolled in a COBOL/Mainframe engineering bootcamp, gaining hands‑on experience with TSO/ISPF, JCL, COBOL, CICS, and broader mainframe concepts.

positions.title: Air Traffic Controller
positions.locationName: Whiteman Air Force Base, Missouri, United States
positions.description:
• Trained to manage high‑stress, fast‑moving situations while maintaining composure, clear communication, and sound decision‑making.
• Coordinated safe and efficient air traffic operations across multiple facilities and up to five or more additional positions within the tower and radar environment.
• Selected to serve as a site lead on a $65M construction project, overseeing more than 15 contractors and 6 security escorts while ensuring compliance, safety, and mission continuity.
• Used personal off‑duty time to learn programming fundamentals beginning with JavaScript and developed an automated, scalable training‑evaluation tool that improved consistency and efficiency in controller training.
• Built strong situational awareness and multitasking abilities by managing simultaneous aircraft, ground traffic, and changing mission requirements.
• Strengthened communication skills through precise, structured, and time‑critical radio and coordination procedures.
